label: Sense, independence and nonvacuity controls for Arrival B in the finite-duration sense
paraphrase: Closed mathematical controls, every individual counted concrete. (1) In the beginningless integer history GrimReaperPatchwork.Control.pivot with the identity clock, contingent concrete things are possibly present and no accessible history is a BEGINS_2 history. (2) In MetricGrimReaper.Control.openBelow (positive real times, identity clock; every individual exists and is present at every moment of world true, nothing exists at world false): Euclidean access and reflexivity at world true hold; B1 holds in sense BEGINS_2 and fails in sense BEGINS_1; B2 in sense BEGINS_2 fails for the empty totality-cause relation; and for every grounding relation no concrete individual is necessary at either world. (3) In openBelowSource (the same with one more individual existing at both worlds and present at no moment, the totality cause at world true): B1 and B2 in sense BEGINS_2, Euclidean access and reflexivity at world true hold, and for every grounding relation a concrete individual is necessary at world true. These are statements about these interpretations only.
